name: Motor DOL Starter with Latch
description: Direct-on-line motor starter. Run latch with Start/Stop interlocking, E-Stop override, overload protection, and status lamps.
safety_notes: Stop_PB is NC-wired: NOT Stop_PB = stop pressed. Emergency_Stop is NC: FALSE = emergency active. Overload signal TRUE = fault detected. Motor_Run is gated by Fault_State as final guard.
common_mistakes: Using normally-open E-Stop logic — opposite of IEC safety convention
Missing overload in the fault condition
